messages.content: What is the largest planet in the universe?

function.name: space_star_info

message.content: The largest planet that has been confirmed so far is **HD 100546 b**, which orbits the young star HD 100546. It has a mass of roughly 6–7 Jupiter masses and a radius about 1.5 times that of Jupiter. Another very massive candidate is **HD 106906 b**, with a mass close to 11 Jupiter masses, but its status as a bound planet is still under investigation. In short, the biggest confirmed planet in our galaxy is HD 100546 b.
